display.purpose: Large ready, paused, and operation-state titles.

title.purpose: Game identity and compact primary titles.

body.purpose: Principally 12px mixed-case explanations, summaries, and settings.

label.purpose: Principally 11px uppercase departments, ledgers, field codes, and control captions.

shadows.name: shell-ambient
shadows.purpose: Separates the bounded application shell from the dark field surround.

shadows.name: debrief-ambient
shadows.purpose: Separates the temporary paper debrief from its modal backdrop.

shadows.name: airfield-status-lift
shadows.purpose: Keeps the serviceability label legible over the Forward Airfield plate.

shadows.name: priority-lift
shadows.purpose: Lifts the time-limited priority action above the battlefield.

shadows.name: command-lift
shadows.purpose: Adds restrained tactile depth to primary vermilion controls.

motion.name: state-plate-fade
motion.purpose: Reveals or clears ready and paused state plates without obscuring operation state.

motion.name: aircraft-heading-turn
motion.purpose: Continuously interpolates airborne headings and visible bank toward movement vectors while ground phases remain level.

motion.name: ground-launch-stagger
motion.purpose: Offsets initial taxi-out and eastbound takeoff rolls so multiple aircraft remain visibly separated.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapses CSS transitions and animations when reduced motion is requested.

rasterAssets.role: 390×560 battlefield and disciplined airfield plate with tent-free lower-right parking apron and left-streaming windsock
Transparent runtime aircraft sprite rendered from 18px ground scale to 40px cruise scale and shrunk on final
Terrain-matched 16-HP soft-emplacement sprite used three times across the lower target row
Terrain-matched 64-HP hardened-bunker sprite used twice across the upper target row

components.name: Primary Command Button
components.description: The unmistakable full-width deployment or Emergency Retreat command; Pause / Resume remains a separate dark control.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 50px; padding: 10px 14px; color: #fff8e8; background: var(--signal); border: 0; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 6px 14px rgba(125,36,28,.22); font: 800 13px 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; letter-spacing: .035em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--signal-dark); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Department Tab
components.description: One half of the Forward Airfield department switcher; the filled state identifies the active workshop.
components.html: <nav class="ds-departments" aria-label="Airfield departments"><button class="ds-department is-active" aria-selected="true">AIRCRAFT MAINTENANCE</button><button class="ds-department" aria-selected="false">ENGINEERING OFFICE</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-departments { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:7px; width:100%; } .ds-department { min-height:52px; padding:8px 10px; color:var(--ink); background:var(--paper-deep); border:0; border-radius:10px; font:700 11px/1.05 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; text-align:left; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; } .ds-department.is-active { color:var(--paper); background:var(--field-dark); } .ds-department:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Pause / Resume Button
components.description: A recognizable labeled dark transport control with a 50px touch target, deliberately separate from the large vermilion Emergency Retreat command.
components.css: .ds-btn-pause { min-width: 50px; min-height: 50px; padding: 4px; display: grid; place-items: center; gap: 1px; color: var(--paper); background: var(--field-dark); border: 0; border-radius: 10px; font: 400 11px 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-pause svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; fill: currentColor; } .ds-btn-pause:hover { background: var(--field-dark); } .ds-btn-pause:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Priority Target Action
components.description: A temporary stacked alert/action control centered over the battlefield.
components.css: .ds-priority { min-width: 220px; min-height: 50px; padding: 8px 16px; color: var(--paper); background: var(--signal-dark); border: 2px solid var(--paper); border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(23,34,31,.28); font-family: 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; } .ds-priority span, .ds-priority strong { display: block; } .ds-priority span { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .09em; } .ds-priority strong { margin-top: 2px; font-size: 14px; } .ds-priority:hover { background: var(--signal-dark); } .ds-priority:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Upgrade Card
components.description: A full-row purchase choice grouping title, effect, and bond cost.
components.css: .ds-upgrade { min-height: 59px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 9px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; color: var(--ink); background: #e4d8b8; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; text-align: left; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-upgrade span, .ds-upgrade strong, .ds-upgrade small { display: block; } .ds-upgrade strong, .ds-upgrade small { font-size: 11px; } .ds-upgrade small { margin-top: 2px; color: var(--ink); line-height:1.2; } .ds-upgrade b { flex: 0 0 44px; color: var(--signal-dark); font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.15; text-align: right; } .ds-upgrade:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--paper-deep); } .ds-upgrade:disabled { color:#525b50; background:#e8dfc7; outline:1px dashed rgba(23,34,31,.28); cursor:not-allowed; } .ds-upgrade:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Sortie Ledger
components.description: A compact tabular readout for unbanked operation earnings.
components.css: .ds-ledger { min-width: 56px; padding: 5px 6px 4px; color: var(--ink); background: var(--paper-deep); border-radius: 8px; text-align: right; font-family: 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-ledger span { display: block; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-ledger strong { display: block; margin-top: 3px; font-size: 16px; }

components.name: Aircraft Recognition Tag
components.description: The compact 43×14px KITE-series call-sign tag attached above 0.65 altitude; it stays hidden near the runway to protect aircraft recognition.
components.css: .ds-flight-tag { width: 43px; height: 14px; padding: 0 3px 0 7px; display: flex; align-items: center; color: var(--ink); background: rgba(239,229,200,.94); border-left: 3px solid var(--signal); font: 700 8px/1 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Forward Airfield Status
components.description: The serviceability plate anchored over the authored Forward Airfield hub image.
components.css: .ds-airfield-status { padding:9px 12px; color:var(--paper); background:rgba(23,34,31,.88); border-radius:8px; box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(23,34,31,.22); font-family:'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; } .ds-airfield-status span,.ds-airfield-status strong { display:block; } .ds-airfield-status span { font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.11em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-airfield-status strong { margin-top:2px; font-size:14px; }

components.html:

components.css: .ds-debrief { position:relative; width:min(calc(100% - 24px),420px); padding:22px; color:var(--ink); background:var(--paper); border-radius:14px; box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.42); font-family:'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; } .ds-debrief>span { color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.11em; } .ds-debrief h2 { margin:2px 0 16px; font-size:24px; line-height:1; } .ds-debrief dl { border-block:1px solid rgba(23,34,31,.22); } .ds-debrief dl div { min-height:38px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; border-bottom:1px solid rgba(23,34,31,.22); } .ds-debrief dl div:last-child { border:0; } .ds-debrief dt { color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.06em; } .ds-debrief dd { margin:0; font-size:17px; font-weight:800; } .ds-debrief-close { position:absolute; top:10px; right:10px; width:44px; height:44px; color:var(--ink); background:transparent; border:0; border-radius:10px; font-size:22px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-debrief-close:hover { background:var(--paper-deep); } .ds-debrief-return { width:100%; min-height:50px; margin-top:14px; color:#fff8e8; background:var(--signal); border:0; border-radius:10px; font-weight:800; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; } .ds-debrief-return:hover { background:var(--signal-dark); } .ds-debrief button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Field Settings Disclosure
components.description: A standard disclosure row for low-frequency settings.
components.html: <details class="ds-settings"><summary>FIELD SETTINGS</summary><label><input type="checkbox" checked> SOUND CUES</label></details>
components.css: .ds-settings { width: 260px; color: var(--ink-soft); border-top: 1px solid rgba(23,34,31,.22); font-family: 'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif; } .ds-settings summary { min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; cursor: pointer; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-settings summary::marker { content: ''; } .ds-settings summary::after { content: '+'; margin-left: auto; font-size: 18px; } .ds-settings[open] summary::after { content: '−'; } .ds-settings label { min-height: 44px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: var(--ink); font-size: 11px; } .ds-settings input { width: 19px; height: 19px; accent-color: var(--signal); } .ds-settings summary:focus-visible, .ds-settings input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Reset Test Progress
components.description: A visible Forward Airfield utility row for clearing prototype progress, always protected by native confirmation.
components.css: .ds-reset { width:100%; min-height:48px; padding:7px 0; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; color:var(--signal-dark); background:transparent; border:0; border-top:1px solid var(--rule); text-align:left; cursor:pointer; } .ds-reset svg { width:20px; height:20px; flex:0 0 auto; fill:currentColor; } .ds-reset span,.ds-reset strong,.ds-reset small { display:block; } .ds-reset strong { font-size:12px; letter-spacing:.035em; } .ds-reset small { margin-top:2px; color:var(--ink-soft); font-size:11px; } .ds-reset:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--focus); outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
The shipped prototype is an operable Forward Airfield rather than an abstract idle dashboard. A realistic authored hangar plate establishes the owned aircraft and its working environment before numbers appear; Maintenance and the Engineering Office then turn upgrades into believable departments within that place. Deployment exchanges the warm airfield for the authored `battlefield-airfield-v2` terrain plate, disciplined runway operations, two compact airborne circuits, and KITE-series aircraft recognition tags.

The material system combines khaki dispatch paper, field-painted green, graphite plotting ink, and sparing signal vermilion with standard web controls. The visual fiction never obscures state: active tabs are filled, unavailable purchases are disabled and outlined, five terrain-matched targets communicate only through their physical sprites and health bars, Emergency Retreat is visually dominant, Pause / Resume remains separate, and both retreat recovery and combat debrief are temporary states on the route back to the Forward Airfield.
keyCharacteristics: A recognizable Forward Airfield hub with Maintenance and Engineering departments.
Realistic authored airfield, battlefield, aircraft, soft-emplacement, and hardened-bunker raster assets as the main atmosphere.

A 390×560 battlefield world with separate center-departure and hangar-side arrival access, right-half eastbound departures, left-half recoveries, loaded and empty airborne circuits, banked 120-degree turns confined to flight, restrained attributable threats, and compact KITE call-sign tags.
Self-hosted Barlow Condensed across display, body, labels, and tabular operation numerals.
Khaki paper, dark field green, graphite, dusty sky, and sparing signal vermilion.
Standard controls, 44px-or-larger targets, explicit states, and interruption-safe behavior.

rules.name: The Signal Discipline Rule
rules.body: Vermilion marks an action, alert, priority, or failure; it is not a general-purpose decoration.

rules.name: The Meaning Beyond Color Rule
rules.body: Every color state is paired with a label, fill change, shape, disabled state, or announcement.

rules.name: The One Workhorse Rule
rules.body: Use the shipped self-hosted Barlow Condensed weights (400, 600, 700, 800); hierarchy comes from role and weight, not extra font families.

rules.name: The Numeral Rule
rules.body: Operation, timing, bond, and sortie figures use tabular numerals wherever changing widths could disturb scanning.

rules.name: The Place-Before-Ledger Rule
rules.body: At the base, show the Forward Airfield plate and serviceable force before exposing purchasing controls; in battle, preserve the 390×560 top-trench/bottom-airfield world before adding overlays.

rules.name: The Restrained Lift Rule
rules.body: Shadows clarify containment or urgency; routine cards and ledgers stay flat and separate through tone.

rules.name: The Recognition Geometry Rule
rules.body: Curves belong to operable containers, target markers, and physical aircraft motion; aircraft silhouettes, field labels, health bars, and recognition-tag leaders stay clipped and technical.

dos: Do keep every interactive target at least 44px in one dimension; primary, pause, and priority controls ship at 50px or more.
Do pair color with words, icons, fill, shape, or live-region announcements for readiness, damage, loss, priority, and disabled states.
Do retain standard button, checkbox, disclosure, focus, keyboard, and confirmation behaviors.
Do honor `prefers-reduced-motion` and the in-game Reduce Effects setting; the latter removes transient canvas effects without removing state information.
Do preserve keyboard controls and polite screen-reader announcements for major operation changes.
Do keep Maintenance and Engineering as visibly distinct, labeled departments within the same Forward Airfield hub.

Do preserve the center x=236 departure access, eastbound right-half departures, left-half arrival roll to x=156, separate hangar-side curved exit, 2.05-second launch staggering, continuous 2π/3-radian-per-second airborne heading turns with visible bank, level ground movement, the loaded inner holding circuit, the empty diagonal return, physical target overflight, and one-strike return behavior.

Do keep integrity loss attributable through brief rifle, anti-air, or enemy-fighter source tracers without large aircraft-centered hit markers; use the recognizable darkened biplane planform for fighter sweeps, vary natural priority timing and position, and keep the confirmed reset action visible on the Forward Airfield.
Do keep the target position to three 16-HP soft emplacements below two 64-HP bunkers, unnamed and identified through terrain-matched silhouettes plus health bars only.
Do rebuild only after all five targets are down and divert the closest loaded airborne aircraft to a marked priority target.
Do preserve sibling JSON provenance, the prompt source, and the retained PNG whenever a runtime WebP is replaced.
donts: Don't turn the shell into a generic dark command-center dashboard, decorative gauge cluster, or neon sci-fi HUD.
Don't use real-world nationalist, extremist, or militarist insignia as atmosphere or ornament.
Don't spend vermilion on passive decoration or rely on it as the only state cue.
Don't replace recognizable controls with ambiguous custom gestures or icon-only interactions.
Don't merge Emergency Retreat with Pause / Resume or give the pause control equal vermilion command weight.
Don't turn the debrief into a persistent third screen; it is a temporary modal record between battle and the Forward Airfield.
Don't reintroduce dashed aircraft route traces; movement is communicated by the aircraft and its continuous heading changes.
Don't restore tents, reverse the left-streaming windsock, or replace the lower-right packed-earth apron in the authored battlefield plate.
Don't substitute generic gradients or CSS scenery for the authored airfield, battlefield, aircraft, emplacement, and bunker assets.
